notes: the first route stands alone and ends at أبا هريرة; the two ح-joined routes meet at «جميعا عن الأوزاعي، بهذا الإسناد», so the Awza'i line and its back reference are written in each of them rather than as a shared tail, because the first route does not converge there
«- يعني ابن يونس -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «ولم يذكر الآخر» and «وقال إذا فرغ أحدكم من التشهد» are wording only, left out
